The FDA recommended that Compass conduct a trial to demonstrate a survival benefit prior to submitting a BLA for tovecimig.
Compass does not believe that a new trial is warranted prior to submitting a BLA based on the data from the Phase 2/3 COMPANION-002 study and the urgent unmet medical need for patients with BTC.
Compass intends to further engage with the FDA as we continue to prepare a BLA submission for tovecimig.
Compass remains confident in tovecimig based on the positive results from COMPANION-002, including the statistically significant improvements in ORR and PFS.
